newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Ramos had significant artery block - doctors.
newsitem.headline: Ramos had significant artery block - doctors.

text.p: Philippine President Fidel Ramos underwent surgery on Monday to remove a significant blockage in one of the body's main arteries, doctors said.
A bulletin issued by the Makati Medical Centre, where Ramos was admitted on Sunday, said angiography tests showed a significant cholestrol-related blockage in the right carotid artery.
The carotids are the two great arteries carrying blood to the head. Health Secretary Carmencita Riodica later told reporters that if the blockage had not been removed, it could have led to a stroke.
Medical centre director Raul Fores said Ramos and his wife had consented to an immediate operation to remove the blockage.
"The president is prsently out of anaesthesia, awake and all vital signs are within normal limits," he said.
"The surgical team are confident that he may be out of the hospital either on Christmas Day or the day after," Fores said.
